description:
HushMessenger v0.0.5 keeps the exact Messenger 580.0.0.49.91 target and its one permission coexistence patch. This preview adds a repeatable changed-APK check: when the tested permission bytecode changes, Morphe stops before rebuilding an APK and names the supported version.

The README now explains how to compare the bundle's SHA-256 and what that check can prove. Morphe Manager 1.32.0 and Desktop 1.17.0 do not verify the source index's detached-signature URL when importing patch bundles, so that field remains empty.

Checks: ten unit tests passed; two clean builds produced the same bundle bytes; the exact stock APK patched and signed off-device; Android verified its v3 signature; the rebuilt manifest has 26 and three renamed permission mentions with no old names; the changed APK failed before output. Signed-in phone behavior, including encrypted chats, calls and notifications, still needs an isolated arm64 test session. The attached S22's stock Messenger data was left intact.

This release contains a Morphe patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. Bring your own unmodified arm64 Messenger 580.0.0.49.91 APK with version code 346013387. Keep your signing key and secure-storage recovery method before replacing any installation.
